owner_request_2026_11_16_fifth.statement_summary: anticipate the mix ahead, make it even faster, load it as soon as a song starts, make the mix intelligent; improve Ket 27 further with iOS 27 animations; before all that, a multiple choice. Chosen: preparation from the start of a title, 2 to 3 titles ahead, separation after download, instant mix on skip; mix points by structure, voice over the other title's instrumental, smart queue; unfolding mini-player, animated icons, spring menus and sheets; iOS settings controls, finish every page.

done.prepare: Automix.prepare from 4 s into a title: ending of the current title, then intro and ending of the next 3 queue entries (1 on a metered network) read on a silent standby deck at 8x (3x behind other apps), measured, and separated on the low-priority stem thread (at most two captures waiting); results kept in AnalysisStore and StemStore; the later transition finds them and only re-reads the sound to apply the stored separation
done.library: StemLibrary: downloaded non-DASH files decoded with MediaExtractor/MediaCodec, intro and ending measured (AnalysisTap) and separated, one title at a time on a background-priority thread, only while charging and while no mix is prepared or played; at most the 300 most recent downloads; woken by ACTION_POWER_CONNECTED and by the downloads list changing; setting ketmixLibrary (on)
done.skip: Automix.skipMix: on a manual next with Ketmix on, when the next entry has a stored intro analysis and an instant source (downloaded, cached or prefetched) and its deck is ready within 1.4 s, a 3.2 s two-deck Filter transition entering at the incoming title's first sound; precise (levels and filters in the decks) only when the outgoing deck's clock was confirmed earlier, else a volume crossfade; otherwise the 5.9.0 fade
done.voice_activity: Separator.mask records per frame the voice's share and level in the 200 Hz-4 kHz band; VoiceActivity turns them into sung passages (30 % share, within 26 dB of the loud moments, runs of 450 ms, rests under 900 ms bridged); StemStore format KVS2 (KVS1 still read); VoiceFacts feeds the planner the later of lyrics/separation for the outgoing voice end and the earlier for the incoming voice start
done.mashup: Mashup.fits (beatmatch with a bass swap, keys read and not clashing, rate within 6 %, overlap of 8 s or more, incoming voice within 40 % of the blend) and both separations covering the blend: the incoming deck plays its separated voice alone (StemAudio.vocals, DeckAutomation.vocalSolo) until the swap, the outgoing deck its instrumental
done.smart_queue: SmartQueue: in shuffle, among the next 6 entries with a stored intro analysis, the best tempo (folded ratio) and key match is moved next when clearly better; never across a title added with Lire ensuite; setting ketmixSmartQueue (on)
done.ket27: by a subagent: PlayerDismiss spring and travelFromMini (phone layout only), SymbolEffects (TransportMorph, FillingHeart, FillingDownloadGlyph, DrawnCheck, pulses), SpringSheet detents in the two sheet hosts (off on Quest), GlassContextMenu on trackRowClick rows, stepped glass sliders/volume/progress/equalizer with haptic ticks, inset ChoiceSpec pickers, Ket27PageBar and large titles on more pages, glass AppAlertDialog, KetCheckbox; all gated on Ket27.on and Motion.reduced; label stays Alpha

differs_from_what_was_proposed: Mix points by structure: no verse/chorus/break map of the whole title was built. The sung passages of the separated intro and ending (at most 50 s each) are used; a title is never left before its last sung part.
Separation after download covers downloaded files only (not favourites that are not downloaded), and only while the app's process is alive and the phone charges.
Finish every page: not finished, Ket 27 stays Alpha (tablet and Quest players, several dialogs, Studio fields, editors, Discord settings, update centre).

known_limitations: Ketmix prepares three titles ahead on unmetered networks and one on mobile data; this reads parts of coming titles and uses data.
A skip is only mixed when the next title is already measured and loads at once; otherwise it fades as before.
A voice over the other title's instrumental needs the separation model, matching tempo and keys, and an incoming title that sings early.
Downloaded titles streamed as DASH are not prepared from their file.
Ket 27 stays an alpha: tablet and Quest players, several dialogs and some pages keep their previous look.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
